CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SAN DIEGO
CLOSED SESSION AGENDA
FOR
Monday, February 02, 2026, AT 10:00 AM
CITY ADMINISTRATION BUILDING
COUNCIL CHAMBERS – 12 TH FLOOR
202 “C” STREET
SAN DIEGO, CA 92101
Virtual Participation: https://sandiego.gov/councilmtg
To join by telephone: Dial 1-669 254 5252 + input Webinar ID: 160 238 7663
_________________
NOTE : In accordance with the San Diego City Council Permanent Rules for Noticing and Conduct of Closed Session Meetings, adopted by Resolution No. R-310153 on December 8, 2015, a portion of the regular open meeting agenda of the City Council has been reserved for City Attorney comment, public comment, and City Council discussion of the content of this Closed Session Agenda. Public testimony for this Closed Session Agenda will be taken today during the 10:00 a.m. Council meeting. Court records about existing litigation are available to the public on the San Diego Superior Court’s Website http://www.sdcourt.ca.gov and Register of Actions http://odyroa.sdcourt.ca.gov .
Conference with Legal Counsel – Existing Litigation, pursuant to California Government Code section 54956.9(d)(1):
CS-1 Alyssa Tutterow v. City of San Diego
San Diego Superior Court Case No. 37-2024-00008001-CU-OE-CTL
Risk Management Department Claim File No. 34875
CDCA Assigned: S. J. Plotkin-Wolff
DCA Assigned: P. H. James
This matter involves allegations of employment discrimination by a former female SDPD officer. The City Attorney’s Office will update the Mayor and City Council on the status of the litigation and seek direction.
CS-2 Maria Natalie Brasil v. City of San Diego
San Diego Superior Court Case No. 37-2020-00012129-CU-PO-CTL
Risk Management Department Claim File No. 22859
DCA Assigned: G. D. Leasure
This case arises out of a trip and fall incident near the intersection of Plum and Lowell Streets in Point Loma on January 10, 2019. The City Attorney’s Office will update the Mayor and City Council on the status of the litigation and seek direction.
CS-3 James Carter v. City of San Diego
San Diego Superior Court Case No. 24CU009508C
Risk Management Department Claim File No. 36333
CDCA Assigned: K. Phillips
This case arises from an employee’s separation from the City of San Diego. The City Attorney’s Office will update the Mayor and City Council on the status of the litigation and seek direction.
